description: Express 5.0 updates path-to-regexp from v0.1 to v8.0, requiring wildcard routes to use named parameter syntax (/{*splat}) instead of raw asterisks (*).

doNot: Do not use bare asterisks in Express 5 routes
Do not pin express<5.0.0 to avoid route syntax upgrades

mutations.description: Replaces wildcard with empty string which misses nested routes
Uses globstar ** which is also invalid in path-to-regexp v8
